Anupam Kher Shares 'Immense Joy' Following 'Ramayana: Part One' Premiere in Los Angeles

31 Oct 2026, 04:15 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: news.abplive.com

Veteran actor Anupam Kher has publicly shared his excitement following the world premiere of *Ramayana: Part One* in Los Angeles. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the multi-part epic project aims to bring the traditional Indian epic to international audiences ahead of a broader global theatrical and IMAX rollout.

Kher, who voices the divine vulture demigod Jatayu in the film, took to social media to express his response to the initial audience feedback emerging from the United States.

Reactions and Casting Details

Following the Los Angeles screening, Kher posted about the international reception. "The early reactions to Ramayana coming in from Los Angeles are filling my heart with immense joy and pride," Kher wrote online. He added that witnessing the narrative reach global viewers on a large scale felt incredible, noting that his involvement voicing Jatayu held special personal significance.

The production team previously introduced Kher's character with official promotional messaging describing the figure as representing the "Wings of Dharma."

Box Office and Advance Sales Indicators

Ahead of its scheduled November 5 release, industry metrics have tracked early ticket sales both domestically and internationally. According to data cited from industry tracker Sacnilk, reported US advance sales for the premiere window experienced an upward shift following the Los Angeles screening, moving from approximately $631,000 to $800,000 over a 24-hour period—marking a reported increase of roughly 27% with eight days remaining until release.

Meanwhile, advance bookings for opening day in India have reportedly reached Rs 12.77 crore gross, excluding block bookings, as promotional activities and anticipation continue to build.
